annotations.title: Find song tempo and drum parts

description: Search the cajon.pro library of Russian and international songs: tempo (BPM), time signature and, for many songs, a drum part — drum sheet music with playback, slow-down and section loop, free online. Search by artist and/or title in any script (Cyrillic or Latin), or list songs at a given tempo. Returns links to the drum part page.

bpm.description: Tempo to look for, beats per minute.

query.description: Artist and/or song title, e.g. «Кино Группа крови» or «Nirvana».
